lesson.scenario: A payments deployment fails over from an active region to a warm passive region using a replicated journal.
entities: Routes clients to the promoted region
Replays state while not serving writes

steps.title: West active
steps.narration: West serves generation 21 while east is warm through journal position 538.
steps.invariant: The passive region must not independently become active without authoritative promotion.

steps.title: Replication catches up
steps.outcome: The warm standby reaches recovery point zero for this moment.
steps.invariant: RPO depends on acknowledged cross-region replication, not standby existence alone.

steps.title: West fails
steps.narration: The health monitor confirms west is unreachable across independent probes.
steps.outcome: Traffic remains paused during the failover decision.
steps.invariant: Promotion criteria must avoid reacting to a single ambiguous network failure.

steps.title: East promoted
steps.narration: The control plane grants east generation 22 and enables writes.
steps.outcome: East becomes the sole valid writer.
steps.invariant: The old active generation must be fenced before or with promotion.

steps.title: Traffic shifts
steps.narration: The director routes new payment sessions to east.
steps.outcome: Service resumes in the passive region after bounded downtime.
steps.invariant: Failback requires reconciliation and is a separate controlled transition.
